# NamoLux

> NamoLux is a name decision workspace for founders. It helps people compare a shortlist of up to 50 candidate names, check availability across six domain extensions, review brand-footprint verification links, apply Founder Signal, and preserve the reasoning behind a final decision.

NamoLux checks .com, .io, .co, .ai, .app, and .dev. Domain availability is best-effort and should be confirmed with a registrar before purchase. Social-profile, company-name, and official UK, US, and EU trade-mark links are research aids, not guarantees of availability or legal clearance. Founder Signal is decision support, not legal or trade-mark advice.

## Product

- [NamoLux home](https://www.namolux.com/): Overview of the name decision workspace and its workflow.
- [Bulk Domain Checker](https://www.namolux.com/bulk-domain-check): Check up to 50 candidate names across six domain extensions and continue into comparison and verification.
- [Founder Signal methodology](https://www.namolux.com/founder-signal): How NamoLux evaluates and explains naming candidates consistently.
- [Pricing](https://www.namolux.com/pricing): Current Free and Pro allowances, decision-record features, and subscription terms.

- [NamoLux Journal](https://www.namolux.com/blog): Practical guidance about startup naming, domain strategy, and due diligence.
- [Why I Built NamoLux](https://www.namolux.com/blog/why-i-built-namolux): Andrew Barrett's account of building a decision-focused naming product.
- [How to check if a business name is taken](https://www.namolux.com/blog/how-to-check-if-business-name-is-taken): A practical name, domain, company, and trade-mark research workflow.
- [Business name vs legal company name vs DBA](https://www.namolux.com/blog/business-name-vs-legal-company-name-vs-dba): The distinctions founders should understand before choosing a name.
- [Best domain extensions in 2026](https://www.namolux.com/blog/best-domain-extensions-2026): A comparison of common startup domain extensions.
- [Founder Signal score explained](https://www.namolux.com/blog/founder-signal-score-explained): Guidance for interpreting Founder Signal without treating it as a verdict.
